title: Algerian Lamb Wrap
description: A flavorful and exotic wrap filled with lamb and crunchy vegetables, inspired by Algerian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Exotic Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern stores

instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb, exotic spice mix, salt, and pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Divide the lamb mixture into 4 equal portions and shape each into a ball. Flatten each ball slightly into a patty.
Grill the lamb patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the tortilla over the grill or in a dry pan for a few seconds on each side.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a tablespoon of olive tapenade on each tortilla, followed by a lamb patty, some shredded carrots, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
